lines: Tu kahin bhi rahe, sar par tere ilzaam to hai
couplets.en: Wherever you may be, the blame still hangs over you.

lines: Tu kahin bhi rahe, sar par tere ilzaam to hai
Tere haathon ki lakeeron mein mera naam to hai
couplets.en: Wherever you may be, the blame still hangs over you, and my name is written in the lines of your hands.

lines: Tu kahin bhi rahe, sar par tere ilzaam to hai

lines: Mujhko tu apna bana ya na bana, teri khushi
Mujhko tu apna bana ya na bana, teri khushi
couplets.en: Call me your own if you wish, the choice is yours.

lines: Mujhko tu apna bana ya na bana, teri khushi
Tu zamaane mein mere naam se badnaam to hai
couplets.en: Call me your own if you wish, though my name has already brought you scandal.

lines: Tu kahin bhi rahe, sar par tere ilzaam to hai
couplets.en: Wherever you may be, the blame still hangs over you.

lines: Mere hisse mein koi jaam na aaya, na sahi
Mere hisse mein koi jaam na aaya, na sahi
couplets.en: If no cup fell to my share, so be it.

lines: Mere hisse mein koi jaam na aaya, na sahi
Teri mehfil mein mere naam koi shaam to hai
couplets.en: If no cup fell to my share, there is still an evening in your company that bears my name.

lines: Tu kahin bhi rahe, sar par tere ilzaam to hai

lines: Dekh kar log mujhe naam tera lete hain
Dekh kar log mujhe naam tera lete hain
couplets.en: When people see me, they speak your name.

lines: Dekh kar log mujhe naam tera lete hain
Is mein main khush hoon, mohabbat ka ye anjaam to hai
couplets.en: When people see me, they speak your name, and I take quiet pleasure in what love has come to.

lines: Woh sitamgar hi sahi, dekh ke usko Shabbir
Woh sitamgar hi sahi, dekh ke usko Shabbir
couplets.en: Even a glimpse of that cruel beloved matters, Shabbir.

lines: Woh sitamgar hi sahi, dekh ke usko Shabbir
Shukr hai is dil-e-bimaar ko aaraam to hai
couplets.en: Cruel as the beloved may be, Shabbir, a glimpse brings this aching heart some rest.
